title: Cook
body:
Syntax: cook <fish>

Description: Cooks a raw fish into a dish for the Cooking job. Hold a Copper Cooking Pot, or stand in your own apartment kitchen to cook without one. Costs 1-2 Stamina and takes a few seconds. Meals can burn. Each pot used loses one use per attempt, even when a meal burns, and breaks after 250 uses by default. Cooking in your own kitchen without a pot uses no tool.

Cooking also raises your Max Chakra -- each Cooking level adds its own level number, stacking cumulatively, same math as Farming uses for Max Stamina. See 'help farm' for the exact math.

Date: 2026-08-17
